thread:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a spike in partial/206 streaming responses from /v1/stream/chat starting ~06:20 UTC. ~1.7k affected requests across two clusters. I pulled a few traces and one looks like the socket closed right after a partial frame.

maya: Do you have example request IDs or a short log snippet? Any correlation with deploys?

alex: Pasted samples below. No deploys in that window.
```
req=cbf7a2 region=us-west status=206 tokens=38 ERR=kvcache-miss; ws_close=EOF
req=cbf7b3 region=eu-central status=206 tokens=12 ERR=write: broken pipe
```

maya: ok thanks. yesterday we saw lower-volume partials that we traced to aggressive client reconnects. Could be multiple things (proxy timeouts, runtime emit behavior, or client code).

jin: I'll check proxy and batcher logs for drains/scale events. If instances are being preempted during long-lived streams that's a likely culprit.

ops-bot: INCIDENT_CREATED: #inc-2026-03-streaming-partials (sev3) — assignees: @alex @jin @maya

sarah: Proposal for ownership split: infra/proxy (reconnect/backoff/scale) -> @jin, runtime/kvcache/emit semantics -> @maya, customer comms & retention changes -> @sarah. Can everyone ack and propose deadlines?

maya: taking runtime. I'll build a small reproducer to simulate mid-stream socket drop + kvcache misses. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

dinesh: I'll run a 48h query to see whether this is a recurring pattern and correlate with autoscaling events. Will report findings by EOD tomorrow.

alex: I'll enumerate affected orgs and DM security for any PII concerns. Also adding initial action items to the postmortem tracker: 
1) add per-request streaming timeline metrics (handshake, first-byte, kvcache-hit, final-close reason) — owner:@maya — due: 2026-03-31
2) implement graceful reconnect/backoff policy in proxy with visible Retry-After header — owner:@jin — due: 2026-03-28
3) extend streaming trace retention 7d->30d for forensic correlation — owner:@sarah — due: 2026-04-05
4) hotfix: increase websocket idle timeout default 15s->30s in gateway for canary pool — owner:@dinesh — due: 2026-03-25

maya: I'll open a PR for the metrics + a dashboard. Test harness will exercise sustained streams with intermittent packet loss.

jin: I'll prototype exponential backoff in the routing proxy and add a log field `partial_emit_reason` so we can distinguish kvcache/oom/socket errors from legitimate partials. Planning a 10% canary rollout in Dedicated next week once tests pass.

sarah: I'll draft a short customer-facing note for tenants who saw degraded streams. @alex please paste the impacted org list in the tracker.

alex: Sent DM with list. Observed one client with 100ms reconnect loop that likely amplified the issue; recommend we surface `Retry-After`/429 on forced disconnects so clients get a deterministic backoff signal.

dinesh: Quick query result: 4 scaling events in the window (06:18-06:23 UTC) aligned with instance drains. I suspect in-flight stream handoffs caused premature finalization. Will attach drain logs to the ticket.

maya: Test plan summary: simulate instance drain, network jitter, and client reconnect behavior in staging at 25% load. Goal: no partial responses for 6h run. Will share CI job next 24h.

jin: Adding rollout checklist to the incident ticket: unit tests, integration in staging, canary 10% traffic, monitor partial_rate < 0.1% for 48h, then gradual ramp.

alex: Scheduling a sync Fri 16:00 UTC for status, blockers, and to close action items. If any customer-impacting regression appears earlier, escalate immediately. :calendar: 

sarah: Thanks team — capturing notes in postmortem doc. We'll also add a recurring check to spot rising partial_rate trends weekly.

alex: One more note — include a short snippet in the diagnostics docs for on-call: how to grep partials and correlate with `instance_drain` events. Example grep: 
```
rg "status=206" streaming-logs | rg "instance_drain|kvcache-miss|ws_close"
```

maya: ack. I'll add the grep and a short playbook to the runbook repo.
